sections.heading: 5. Cookies Policy
sections.text:
We are committed to being transparent about the technologies we use on our Services.
A. Do we use cookies?
We do not set proprietary HTTP cookies on your device through the Services. We do not use local Storage.
We make limited use of session Storage — a browser-based storage mechanism that exists only for the duration of a single browser session and is automatically deleted when the browser tab or window is closed. Specifically, a technical flag ("adobeCleanFontAdded") is written to session Storage by the font loading infrastructure to prevent duplicate font loading requests within a session. This entry contains no personal data and is not used for tracking, profiling, or analytics purposes.
B. What is a cookie?
A cookie is a small text file placed on your device by a web page server. Cookies contain information that can later be read by a web server in the domain that issued the cookie. Similar technologies include session Storage and local Storage, which allow websites to store data locally in your browser. session Storage holds data only for the duration of a single browser session; local Storage persists across sessions until manually cleared.
C. Third-party requests.
The Services load web font assets from Google Fonts (fonts.googleapis.com and fonts.gstatic.com). When your browser requests these assets, your IP address and browser data may be transmitted to Google's servers. This is handled in accordance with Google's Privacy Policy (policies.google.com/privacy). No advertising networks, third-party analytics platforms, or tracking pixels are loaded by the Services.
D. Wallet browser extensions.
If you have a Solana-compatible wallet browser extension installed (such as Phantom or Solflare), that extension may independently write its own data to your browser's session Storage or local Storage when active on any web page, including our Services. Such data is set by the wallet extension itself, not by us, and is governed by the respective wallet provider's privacy policy.
E. How to manage cookies and storage.
You can manage, block, or delete cookies and browser storage through your browser's privacy or security settings. Doing so will not materially affect the functionality of the Services, as the Services do not depend on proprietary cookies or local Storage. For detailed guidance, please visit www.aboutcookies.org.

Please note that we have no ability to delete data that is stored on the Solana blockchain. Blockchain transaction data, including wallet addresses and transaction history, is stored on a public, immutable ledger and cannot be modified or erased by us.

sections.heading: About Seasons
sections.text: Seasons is an autonomous on-chain yield protocol making real-asset returns accessible to anyone with a Solana wallet — no banks, no intermediaries, no minimum wealth requirements.

sections.heading: Real yield, for everyone
sections.text:
Our mission
Real yield, for everyone
The financial system has always distributed the best yields to those who need them least. Wealthy institutions access yield-generating assets — gold, bonds, real estate — that ordinary savers cannot. Seasons changes this. By building yield distribution directly into a token's economics, anyone who holds $SEAS earns real-asset returns twice a week, automatically. No relationship manager required. No minimum account size. No paperwork.

sections.heading: Autonomous by design
sections.text:
How we build
Autonomous by design
The Seasons protocol is designed to operate without human intervention. TTT fees are collected on-chain by the SPL-2022 token standard. The Yield Management System (YMS) converts them to the Inclusion Set assets automatically. Distribution to node wallets happens on-chain, on schedule, without anyone pressing a button. The team's role is to set parameters, evolve the system, and eventually hand control to the DAO.

Culture
Protocol-first, community-always
The Seasons team operates on a simple principle: the protocol should work perfectly whether or not any team member shows up today. Every critical system is automated, every decision is documented, and every community commitment is honored on schedule. We build for the node holders — the people who have put their capital behind this vision.

sections.heading: Partner Program
sections.text: Join the Seasons ecosystem as a distribution partner. Earn referral commissions across seven tiers — from Seed (5%) to Eternal (30%) — by bringing new node holders into the protocol.

sections.heading: Earn for growing the network
sections.text:
How it works
Earn for growing the network
The Seasons Partner Program rewards individuals and organizations who bring new participants into the protocol. Partners receive a percentage of the yield earned by referred node holders for as long as those nodes remain active. Tier advancement is based on cumulative referred node volume — the more active nodes you bring in, the higher your commission rate.

sections.heading: Seven tiers from Seed to Eternal
sections.text:
Partner tiers
Seven tiers from Seed to Eternal
5%
Seed
Entry tier. Awarded to new partners at signup. Earns 5% of referred nodes' yield.
10%
Sprout
First advancement tier. Achieved by building a qualifying base of active referred nodes.
15%
Growth
Mid-tier. For partners who have demonstrated consistent node referral activity.
20%
Bloom
Advanced tier for high-volume partners with substantial active node networks.
25%
Harvest
Elite tier. Reserved for top-performing partners with large, stable referred node bases.
28%
Perennial
Near-maximum tier for the protocol's most impactful long-term partners.
30%
Eternal
Maximum commission tier. Awarded to founding partners and exceptional ecosystem contributors.

Media contact
Get in touch
For press inquiries, interview requests, or fact-checking assistance, contact the Seasons communications team at press@seasons.wtf. We respond to all press inquiries within 48 hours. For urgent breaking news requests, mention [URGENT] in the subject line.

sections.heading: Protocol at a glance
sections.text:
Quick facts
Protocol at a glance
Launched
2024
Seasons protocol launched on Solana mainnet with the $SEAS token and HYSA yield product.
Supply
1,000,000,000 $SEAS
Fixed total supply, no inflation, no new minting. Deflationary pressure from buyback track.
Yield
Real assets, twice weekly
Gold (XAUt0), Bitcoin (wBTC), and USD (jlUSDc) distributed proportionally to all active nodes.
